Marie Curie was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize, and she won two Nobel Prizes in different fields. She was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1903, along with her husband Pierre Curie and Henri Becquerel, for their pioneering work on radioactivity.

Later, in 1911, Marie Curie was awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for her work on the isolation of pure radium, which was a major achievement in the field of chemistry at the time
rows.reference_fr: La première femme à remporter un prix Nobel était Marie Curie, qui a reçu le prix Nobel de physique en 1903, ainsi que le prix Nobel de chimie en 1911.
rows.out:

rows.prompt_en: Which is the largest island in the world?
rows.prompt_usado: Quelle est la plus grande île du monde?
rows.baseline_en:
The largest island in the world is Greenland, which is an autonomous territory within the Kingdom of Denmark. It covers an area of approximately 2,166,086 square kilometers (836,330 square miles), making it the largest island in the world by land area.

Greenland is about the size of Mexico and is located between the Arctic and Atlantic Oceans, northeast of Canada. It has a population of around 56,000 people, mostly Inuit, and is known for its vast ice sheets
rows.reference_fr: La plus grande île du monde est l'île Groenland, qui fait partie du Groenland, un territoire autonome de la Danemark.
rows.out:
La plus grande île du monde est l'île de Groenland, qui fait partie du Groenland, un territoire autonome de la Danemark. Cependant, si l'on considère les îles qui font partie d'un pays, la plus grande île du monde est l'île de Borneo, qui fait partie de la Malaisie, de l'Indonésie et du Brunei.
